name: What daily cleaning routine keeps bathroom marble in good condition?

mainEntity.name: What daily cleaning routine keeps bathroom marble in good condition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Clean bathroom marble using warm water, a soft microfiber cloth, and a dedicated pH-neutral stone cleaner. Avoid standard household bathroom sprays, vinegar, lemon juice, bleach, ammonia, and abrasive scouring pads, as these dissolve calcium carbonate and permanently etch the stone surface. Squeegee shower walls after each use to minimize mineral deposits and soap scum buildup. Wipe up spills from cosmetics, hair dyes, and facial cleansers immediately to keep pigments from penetrating the porous stone.
acceptedAnswer.description: Use only pH-neutral stone cleaners and soft cloths. Avoid vinegar, bleach, and abrasive scrubs. Squeegee shower walls after use and wipe up cosmetic spills immediately to avoid etching and stains.
